result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.clear_selection()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Clear all node and edge selections. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L6205-L6240){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.clear_selection() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Resets the selection state, unmarking all previously selected nodes and edges. Useful for starting fresh with a new selection workflow. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Reset selection state: ::: {#4b9049d7 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_star_graph(5) .select_nodes_by_degree(min_degree=3) .clear_selection() ) # No nodes selected after clearing count = graph.count_selected_nodes() # Returns 0 count ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 0 ``` ::: :::
